scope: Post-attention residual replay; native LN2→MLP→residual/bias→next LN1. No autoregressive loop.

protocol.mutations: Select a predeclared raw input fixture and advance generation. No calculated answer injection.
protocol.timing: In-browser mutation to first generation-tagged final dependent geometry read; asynchronous completion includes native frame waits. All-coordinate numerical serialization follows the timer.
protocol.correctness: Every warmup and measured generation is checked after its completion, not just the timed final scalar.
protocol.load: Navigation + explicit loading of every declared FontFace + document.fonts.ready recorded separately; native gated projection fonts otherwise load late. No other benchmark pages resident.
protocol.order: AB then BA for two variants; alternating reversal otherwise
protocol.quantiles: Upper-middle median, nearest-rank p90; process medians and paired differences retained. Two pairs are not a precision confidence interval.
caveats: External16ms polling and DevTools round trips can perturb scheduling and add observation delay; same observer in both variants. Synchronous candidate may complete on its first read.
No full-model token runtime may be inferred by multiplying this segment latency.
